reviews.title: Can you be awestruck by a computer case?
reviews.comment: THE most beautiful, well designed, and excellently crafted case I've ever used, and I've built more than 20 systems over the years. The packaging was great, the accessories were in their own box - including zip ties for the cables - and it came with a manual. For a case! The quality of the construction is top notch, and the sound-deadening materials are industrial-caliber. The wire routing channels and access points are also well laid out. It really is an awe-inspiring case if you like the solid metal look, and appreciate the highest level of case design.
reviews.author: Barry T

reviews.title: Do Not Buy Unless Using Small GPUs
reviews.comment: I was mislead by Fractal Design YouTube channel into thinking this case was compatible with current generation bigger GPUs such as the 3080, 3080ti, 3090, 3090ti, 4080, and 4090. Turns out the case can only fit longer graphics cards if the front GPU fan is removed?!? The whole damn point of the case is to get the majority of the intake air from the front for silence! I wish I could go back in time and have actually read the manual online instead of watching a video on the case from the manufacturer which I thought would be more informative. This case is a disgrace to the Define Series and should be on a Gamer's Nexus Worst Micro ATX Cases video if he ever made one. If they were going to put their foot down on making the depth of the case so small, then either should moved the power supply to the top. I'm now stuck with my GPU getting very hotbecause doing a refund through Newegg meant I would actually lose money paying for restocking fee and gas to drive the case to UPS/FedEx for shipping.
reviews.author: Alex Review
